    x += y
    if x >= MOD:
        x -= MOD
    return x

    try:
        n, m, MOD = map(int, input().split())
    except EOFError:

    binom = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
    for i in range(m + 1):
        binom[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            binom[i][j] = binom[i - 1][j - 1] + binom[i - 1][j]
            if binom[i][j] >= MOD:
                binom[i][j] -= MOD

    prefix_sum = [0] * (m + 1)
    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        prefix_sum[i] = prefix_sum[i - 1] + i

    ways = [0] * (m + 1)
    sum_ = [0] * (m + 1)
    ways[0] = 1
    sum_[0] = 0

    for size in range(1, m + 1):
        for split in range(size):
            left = split
            right = size - 1 - split
            prod_ways = ways[left] * ways[right] % MOD

            # Update ways[size]
            ways[size] = add_value(ways[size], (size + 1) * binom[size - 1][split] % MOD * prod_ways % MOD)

            # sum_part
            sum_part = 0
            sum_part = add_value(sum_part, sum_[left] * ways[right] % MOD)
            sum_part = add_value(sum_part, sum_[right] * ways[left] % MOD)

            # Update sum_[size]
            sum_[size] = add_value(sum_[size], (size + 1) * binom[size - 1][split] % MOD * sum_part % MOD)

            # total_sum_part
            total_sum_part = 0
            total_sum_part = add_value(total_sum_part, prefix_sum[left] * ways[right] % MOD)
            total_sum_part = add_value(total_sum_part, prefix_sum[right] * ways[left] % MOD)

            # Update sum_[size]
            sum_[size] = add_value(sum_[size], (size + 1) * binom[size - 1][split] % MOD * total_sum_part % MOD)

    ways2 = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    sum2 = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    ways2[0][0] = 1
    sum2[0][0] = 0

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(min(i, m) + 1):
            ways2[i][j] = ways2[i - 1][j]
            sum2[i][j] = sum2[i - 1][j]
            for k in range(1, j + 1):
                ni = max(0, i - k - 1)

                ways2[i][j] = add_value(ways2[i][j], ways[k] * ways2[ni][nj] % MOD * binom[j][k] % MOD)
                sum2[i][j] = add_value(sum2[i][j], (sum_[k] * ways2[ni][nj] + ways[k] * sum2[ni][nj]) % MOD * binom[j][k] % MOD)

    print(sum2[n][m])
